product_one_liner.value: koppla helps general contractors, general planners, property developers and architects schedule construction projects and reduce project-delivery risks.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage names general contractors, general planners, property developers and architects, and describes faster scheduling and reduced project-process risks: https://www.koppla.de/.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page describes project and company licenses, including unlimited users: https://www.koppla.de/preise. Public numerical prices are not required by the question.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The investor announcement explicitly identifies Implenia, Max Bögl and Leonhard Weiss as customers, rather than partners or investors: https://www.ilb.de/de/presse/pressemitteilungen/pressemitteilung_2049984.html. | named_customers.0: Implenia is explicitly named as a customer: https://www.ilb.de/de/presse/pressemitteilungen/pressemitteilung_2049984.html. | named_customers.1: Max Bögl is explicitly named as a customer: https://www.ilb.de/de/presse/pressemitteilungen/pressemitteilung_2049984.html. | named_customers.2: Leonhard Weiss is explicitly named as a customer: https://www.ilb.de/de/presse/pressemitteilungen/pressemitteilung_2049984.html.

employee_band.notes: The about page states 38 employees, while the careers page states 27 people. Although the exact counts differ, both fall within 21-50: https://www.koppla.de/das-ist-koppla and https://koppla.de/karriere.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company's imprint gives its address as Schopenhauerstraße 19, 14467 Potsdam, Germany: https://koppla.de/imprint. This establishes its registered location; the company profile also identifies Potsdam. | hq_country: The company imprint gives its address as Potsdam, Deutschland: https://koppla.de/imprint. This establishes its registered location; the company profile also identifies Potsdam as its location.

founded_year.notes: The investor announcement explicitly says koppla was founded in 2020: https://www.ilb.de/de/presse/pressemitteilungen/pressemitteilung_2049984.html.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed blog index contains construction-management advice, product announcements, integrations and event marketing, rather than at least two engineer-authored posts about building the software: https://www.koppla.de/blog. Construction-engineering topics were not counted as software-engineering posts.

public_docs.notes: The public help center contains multiple collections with numerous articles, including seven welcome articles, nineteen planning articles and twelve project-control articles: https://support.koppla.de/de.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current English job board lists Founders Associate—GTM/RevOps/Growth and Senior Product Engineer—Coding & People Leadership. Neither title qualifies as an AI, ML or data-science role: https://koppla.jobs.personio.de/?language=en.

model_provider.notes: Unknown. The AI product page describes AI-assisted project import and hosting safeguards but names no model or model provider. No model provider was identified in the reviewed blog, help-center material, privacy pages or public subprocessor listing. Sources: https://www.koppla.de/kuenstliche-intelligenz-mit-koppla, https://www.koppla.de/blog, https://support.koppla.de/de and https://security.koppla.de/. AWS appearing as a subprocessor was not treated as evidence of an AI model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The public Trust Center lists GDPR and ISO/IEC 27001 under compliance, without an in-progress qualifier in the reviewed content. These are reported as public claims, not independently verified certifications: https://security.koppla.de/. | compliance_certs.0: GDPR is explicitly listed in koppla's Trust Center: https://security.koppla.de/. | compliance_certs.1: ISO/IEC 27001 is explicitly displayed as a compliance item. The reviewed listing does not describe it as in progress: https://security.koppla.de/.

last_funding.notes: normalizer: no stage, so recorded as unknown (funding_date="2025-05", funding_amount_usd=6800000.0) | funding_stage: Unknown because sources conflict on the stage. Seedtable labels the round Series A, another company-data source labels the Newion round Seed, and Tech.eu calls it Other. The primary investor announcement does not specify a stage. Sources: https://seedtable.com/companies/koppla, https://funding.tech.eu/companies/koppla-10ab2ad0 and https://www.ilb.de/de/presse/pressemitteilungen/pressemitteilung_2049984.html. No stage was inferred from the amount. | funding_date: The investor announcement is dated May 19, 2025, and the funding history lists the latest round on that date. Both support 2025-05: https://www.ilb.de/de/presse/pressemitteilungen/pressemitteilung_2049984.html and https://funding.tech.eu/companies/koppla-10ab2ad0. | funding_amount_usd: Seedtable reports the last funding amount as USD 6.8 million: https://seedtable.com/companies/koppla. The investor announcement describes the corresponding May 2025 round as EUR 6 million: https://www.ilb.de/de/presse/pressemitteilungen/pressemitteilung_2049984.html. The USD value is the published database figure, not a newly calculated conversion.

raised_18mo.notes: The EUR 6 million round was announced on May 19, 2025, within the requested eighteen-month window. Both the public investor announcement and Newion's investment announcement support this: https://www.ilb.de/de/presse/pressemitteilungen/pressemitteilung_2049984.html and https://newion.com/news/why-we-invested-in-koppla.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Neither position on the reviewed current job board is titled SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account executive. The GTM-focused Founders Associate role does not meet the title requirement: https://koppla.jobs.personio.de/?language=en.

launched_6mo.notes: The May 27, 2026 announcement introduces a new BIM integration that automatically links schedules to 4D-BIM tools using matching keys. This is a substantive feature within the six-month window, not a bug fix or UI tweak: https://www.koppla.de/blog/bim-in-koppla.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown. The team roster lacks leadership start dates, and public leadership listings do not establish a complete, consistent dated history. Fabian Schaeffer's VP Revenue start was September 2025, outside the requested window, so it does not establish an in-window change. Sources: https://koppla.de/karriere, https://linkedin.com/in/fabianschaeffer and https://getlatka.com/companies/koppla/contacts.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable GTM/RevOps job posting discusses CRM maintenance, pipeline reporting and commercial workflows but names no CRM or sales/marketing platform. This supports an empty list under the stated rule, not a claim that koppla uses no CRM: https://koppla.jobs.personio.de/job/2870964?language=en.
